"overall": "The psalm reads faithfully and mostly has a sober, prayable rhythm. The theophany verses (17-21) sound strongest. What most betrays it as a translation is a handful of word choices that carry the wrong modern overtones: 'exercitar-se', 'invenções', 'a direita', 'muito estrondo'.
